facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance and PPDA rolled out eGP 2.0 to another 100 public entities on 20 July 2026, bringing the total using the platform to 136, and entities already migrated may not advertise tenders in newspapers (Daily Monitor, citing PPDA and the Acting Accountant General).

The Acting Accountant General said under eGP 2.0 suppliers submit bids, receive notifications and sign contracts electronically, with registration mandatory for firms seeking government business and all 441 procuring entities to migrate by 2029.
